When both 𝜆 and 𝜇 have only non-negative integer entries, integer points in GT ( 𝜆, 𝜇 ) are in one-to-one correspondence with semi-standard Young tableaux with shape 𝜆 and content 𝜇 . (This correspondence is obtained by interpreting the 𝑖 th row of a pattern with integral entries as the shape of the sub-tableaux consisting only of entries in { 1 , 2 , . . . , 𝑖 } .) In particular, the number of integral points in GT ( 𝜆, 𝜇 ) is then equal to the Kostka number 𝐾𝜆,𝜇 . We thus refer to the polytope GT ( 𝜆, 𝜇 ) as a Kostka polytope.
